Body.Content:
Administrators can now assign Microsoft Dataverse group teams backed by Microsoft Entra groups to Business performance planning dimension security groups. Previously, dimension security assignments were limited to individual users. The updated experience allows administrators to view and add eligible Entra group-backed teams alongside users, with separate membership information for each assignment type.

To use this capability, the Dataverse group team must first be configured correctly and assigned an appropriate Business performance planning security role.

More info: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/business-performance-planning/bpp-security

GA date: October CY2026
